test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of November 2020, who was the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Kumar **is an **Indian economist **who served as the **second vice-chairman **of the **NITI Aayog**.
 
• He was the **vice chairman of NITI Aayog **from **2017-2020**.
 
• He also **serves as the Chancellor **of **Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics**, Pune.
 
• **NITI Aayog **is **developing itself **as **a state-of-the-art **resource center with the **necessary knowledge and skills**
 
• That will enable it to act with speed, promote research and innovation, provide a strategic policy vision for the government, and deal with contingent issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urjit Patel **is an **Indian economist**, who formerly **served as the 24th Governor of the Reserve Bank **of **India **and also **Deputy Governor **of **Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• **Bibek Debroy **is an **Indian economist**, serving as the **chairman of the Economic Advisory Council **to the **Prime Minister of India**.
 
• **Ravi Shankar Prasad **is an **Indian politician and lawyer**, from the **Bharatiya Janata Party**. A Member of **Parliament since 2000**, first in the **Rajya Sabha **and then in the **Lok Sabha.**
